# Orbit 0.3.0

Artwork picker grid across all providers, random SteamGridDB artwork, and guaranteed artwork + title correction on import.

## Highlights

- **Browse images** on Edit Properties opens a grid of artwork from SteamGridDB, TheGamesDB, RAWG, Wikimedia, and the Steam Store — filter by source and pick with controller or mouse
- **Random SteamGridDB** per slot (icon, cover, hero) rolls a new image for the matched game
- Every imported game now gets artwork in all slots, and importer titles are corrected from a confident provider match
- Auto-enrich also retries existing games that are still missing artwork

## What's included

### Added

- Multi-provider artwork picker grid with per-source filters and provider warnings
- Random SteamGridDB artwork per slot (avoids repeating the previous roll)
- `search_game_artwork` Tauri command
- Guaranteed artwork after import (reused slot or generated placeholder that stays eligible for enrichment)

### Changed

- SteamGridDB matching by Steam app ID or exact normalized title; stricter TheGamesDB matching
- Enrichment works without a TheGamesDB key and retries games missing artwork on rescan
- HTTP timeouts; provider errors no longer include request URLs

### Fixed

- Non-image downloads (e.g. HTML error pages) are no longer cached as artwork
- One failed artwork download no longer aborts enrichment for a game

## Setup

Random artwork needs a [SteamGridDB](https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api) API key in **Settings → Metadata enrichment**. TheGamesDB and RAWG keys add more sources to the picker.

## Install

**Requirements:** macOS 12+, Apple Silicon (CI publishes `aarch64` builds).

1. Download **`Orbit-0.3.0-aarch64.dmg`** below
2. Open the DMG and drag **Orbit** to Applications
3. Launch from Applications — grant permissions if macOS prompts for file access

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Build from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit.git
cd orbit
yarn install
yarn tauri:dev
yarn release:macos
```

See [RUNNING.md](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit/blob/main/RUNNING.md) and [docs/THEMES.md](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit/blob/main/docs/THEMES.md).
